messages.content: "你能幫我創作一首D小調、每分鐘120拍的音樂，然後產生一個頻率為440赫茲、振幅為0.5的音訊訊號嗎？之後，我想要創作另一首E大調、每分鐘90拍、拍子記號為3/4的音樂。最後，產生另一個頻率為300赫茲、振幅為0.7、持續5秒的音訊訊號。"

function.name: audio_generate
function.description: Generate an audio signal given a frequency, amplitude, and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

frequency.description: Frequency of the audio signal in Hz.

amplitude.description: Amplitude of the audio signal. This is a float type value.

duration.description: Duration of the audio signal in seconds. Default is 1 second if not specified. This is a float type value.

function.name: music_generate
function.description: Generate a piece of music given a key, tempo, and time signature. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

key.description: The key of the piece, e.g., C Major.

tempo.description: Tempo of the piece in beats per minute.

time_signature.description: Time signature of the piece, e.g., 4/4. Default is '4/4' if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to create music pieces and generate audio signals. We have two functions: audio_generate and music_generate. The user wants:

1. Create a piece of music in D minor, 120 bpm. No time signature specified, default 4/4. So call music_generate with key "D Minor", tempo 120.

2. Generate an audio signal with frequency 440 Hz, amplitude 0.5. Duration unspecified, default 1 second. So call audio_generate with frequency 440, amplitude 0.5.

3. Create another piece of music in E major, 90 bpm, time signature 3/4. So call music_generate with key "E Major", tempo 90, time_signature "3/4".

4. Generate another audio signal with frequency 300 Hz, amplitude 0.7, duration 5 seconds. So call audio_generate with frequency 300, amplitude 0.7, duration 5.

We need to call the functions in order. The user wants all these. We should produce the function calls. The instructions: "When calling a function, provide the arguments as JSON." So we need to produce separate function calls. The system expects us to call the functions. We can call them sequentially. The output should be the function calls. We should not add any extra text. Just the function calls. The user wants all four. So we produce four calls.

We need to use the correct function names: functions.music_generate and functions.audio_generate. Provide JSON arguments.

Thus:

First call: functions.music_generate({"key":"D Minor","tempo":120})

Second: functions.audio_generate({"frequency":440,"amplitude":0.5})

Third: functions.music_generate({"key":"E Major","tempo":90,"time_signature":"3/4"})

Fourth: functions.audio_generate({"frequency":300,"amplitude":0.7,"duration":5})

We need to output each call. Probably each on separate lines.
